data.description: Each natural attack threatens a critical hit on a 19 or 20.  Feats like Improved Critical can increase this range further.  If the ravener scores a critical hit with a natural weapon, the target gains 1 negative level.  The DC to remove this negative level is %1.  Whenever a creature gainst a negative level in this way, the ravener adds 5 points to its soul ward.
